text:
ashley (eng): Heads-up: we have a deploy window tomorrow 09:30 UTC for release v2.3. Plan is canary -> staggered roll -> full. Canary ramp: 10% @ 0m, 50% @ 10m, 100% @ 30m. Need final release notes by 08:30 UTC and cross-team readiness check here. Who's owning monitoring & rollback?

mike (sre): I got monitoring & rollback hooks. I'll be on pager for the window. Will run health checks and watch error rates + 1m latency p95.

nina (cs): CS will take first-line for customer questions. I'll prepare canned responses and an internal KB. @leo (product) can you share the quick list of customers who get early access / VIP?

leo (product): Sending VIP list now in DM. Also flag: new-ranking feature is behind FF flag `new-ranking` — we'll keep it off for the broader traffic until metrics look good.

omar (marketing): Marketing will publish blog + tweet at 11:00 UTC. Need final headline and approved screenshot assets by 09:00 UTC. Release notes lock at 08:30 works for us. Also confirm the short blurb for the console changelog.

priya (docs): I'll land the user docs and API changelog updates before the deploy, plan to merge by 08:45. PR: #742. I'll also add a short note in the release-notes page and a redirect for the old example.

ashley (eng): Smoke checklist (brief):
- `make smoke` in staging passes
- end-to-end sample flow (signup -> inference) under 1s median
- no obvious errors in logs for 10m after canary start
- KV cache warmup completes for top 3 models

mike (sre): Smoke script is `./scripts/smoke-check.sh`. I'll run it at 09:00 UTC and post results here. If anything fails we stop the rollout. Ramp policy is manual approval at 10m.

priya (docs): Small note on changelog wording: avoid technical jargon for Marketing. I'll add a TL;DR section.

mike (sre): Rollback command (if needed):
```
# rollback to last stable tag
./ops/deploy --rollback --tag v2.2.9 --env prod
```
I'll coordinate the actual rollback and call out in this thread when done.

nina (cs): CS canned response draft (short):
"We're rolling out an update to improve inference throughput. You may see brief latency fluctuations during the rollout. If you experience errors, please reply here or email support@redwood.ai with trace id."
I'll paste full template by 08:00.

ashley (eng): One more: feature flags will be toggled via the FF console. During canary we'll enable `new-ranking` only for the 10% cohort. We won't flip on for full until metrics green.

leo (product): I'll own the acceptance metrics: p95 latency, error >1% alert, and quality delta on eval set. Posting the eval link in 2m.

deploy-bot: scheduled deployment v2.3 canary at 1955097400 (09:30 UTC) by ashley (eng).

omar (marketing): Acked. We'll stand by for assets. :rocket:

nina (cs): I'll be available 09:15-12:00 UTC. Templates incoming. :white_check_mark:

ashley (eng): Perfect — I'll post a final "GO/NO-GO" at 08:45 UTC after smoke run. If anyone needs to change slotted times DM me. Thanks all. :v:
